GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 601 (11 Dec 45) ESS/ST
(SCAPIN - 425)
APO 500
11 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Use of the 7th Army Technical Laboratory
1. Approval is given for the use of buildings and grounds of the Seventh Army Technical Laboratory as a research laboratory for construction engineering.
2. Monthly reports of activities at the laboratory are to be submitted in accordance with General Headquarters Directive No. 3 paragraph 8c.
3. An acknowledgement of the receipt of this memorandum is directed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
